content_sections.heading: APPSC DIET Lecturer Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: APPSC has announced 160 provisional vacancies across three lecturer categories under A.P. School Education Services. The following table provides the confirmed vacancy, age, salary, application and selection details from Brief Notification No. 30/2026. Register for Job Alerts Important: The 160 vacancies are provisional and may change following confirmation from the concerned department. APPSC will specify post-wise educational qualifications and the detailed examination scheme in a subsequent notification.

content_sections.heading: APPSC DIET Lecturer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application process for APPSC DIET Lecturer Recruitment 2026 will begin on 18 November 2026. Eligible candidates can submit applications until 8 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. The Commission has stated that the detailed notification will be published on or before the application opening date.

content_sections.heading: APPSC DIET Lecturer Vacancy 2026 Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission has announced 160 provisional vacancies for Senior Lecturer DIET, Lecturer SCERT and Lecturer DIET positions. Lecturer DIET has the highest number of vacancies with 104 posts, followed by Senior Lecturer DIET with 46 posts.

content_sections.heading: APPSC DIET Lecturer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC DIET Lecturer Recruitment 2026 notification covers Senior Lecturer DIET, Lecturer SCERT and Lecturer DIET posts. Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualification as on the date of the detailed notification. The brief notification states that post-wise educational qualifications will be specified in the detailed recruitment notification. Candidates should verify the exact degree, specialization and other eligibility requirements before applying.

content_sections.heading: APPSC DIET Lecturer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for APPSC DIET Lecturer Recruitment 2026 is 18 years, and the maximum age is 44 years as on 1 July 2026. This age range applies to all three advertised post categories.

content_sections.heading: APPSC DIET Lecturer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC DIET Lecturer salary varies by post. Senior Lecturer DIET carries a pay scale of Rs. 61,960–1,51,370, Lecturer SCERT carries Rs. 57,700–1,82,400, and Lecturer DIET carries Rs. 54,060–1,40,540. The figures above represent the advertised pay scales, not monthly take-home salary.

content_sections.heading: APPSC DIET Lecturer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: APPSC has confirmed that recruitment to the advertised lecturer posts will involve a single-level Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT). There will be no separate screening test, irrespective of the number of applications received. Single-level examination. Online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT). No separate screening test. Normalization of marks may be applied if the examination is conducted in multiple sessions. APPSC will provide the detailed examination scheme and syllabus in due course.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for APPSC DIET Lecturer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply through the official APPSC website from 18 November to 8 December 2026. Applications must be submitted online only. Visit the official APPSC website at https://psc.ap.gov.in/ . Find Brief Notification No. 30/2026 for Senior Lecturer DIET, Lecturer SCERT and Lecturer DIET posts. Read the detailed recruitment notification and post-wise eligibility requirements when published. Open the online application facility for the recruitment. Follow the registration or login instructions provided by APPSC. Enter the required personal, educational and other application details accurately. Complete the application requirements specified in the detailed notification. Review the completed form and submit it before 8 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Retain the submitted application details for future reference. Important: APPSC accepts applications only through the prescribed online mode. Candidates should read the detailed notification before submitting their applications.

faq.question: Q1. What is APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: APPSC Recruitment 2026 is a direct recruitment drive conducted by the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission for 160 Senior Lecturer and Lecturer posts in A.P School Education Services.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 160 provisional vacancies have been announced, which include 46 vacancies for Senior Lecturer D.I.E.T, 10 vacancies for Lecturer S.C.E.R.T, and 104 vacancies for Lecturer D.I.E.T.

faq.question: Q3. When do online applications start for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
Q4. What is the last date to apply for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 8 December 2026 up to 11:59 P.M.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is 18 to 44 years as reckoned on 1 July 2026.
